content.query:
STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT  CustomerAccountId ,LimitTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit  -- WHERE CustomerAccountId = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId ,LimitTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING count(1) > 1


--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId ,LimitTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ORDER BY CustomerAccountId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO Bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit_WITH_DUP_20230615  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit_WITH_DUP_20230615
--102316507

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit
--102316507


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[CustomerAccountId]
,[LimitTypeId]
,[Timestamp]
,[LimitAmount]
,[LimitEndTimestamp]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM Bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit_WITH_DUP_20230615 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  CustomerAccountId ,LimitTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit  -- WHERE CustomerAccountId = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId ,LimitTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
HAVING count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit_WITH_DUP_20230615
--102316507
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.CustomerAccountLimit
--102316507
